title: Temporal speckle enables probabilistic weights for uncertainty-aware photonic AI
abstract: arXiv:2512.02217v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Artificial intelligence increasingly guides decisions in safety-critical settings, yet neural networks can remain overconfident when confronted with ambiguous observations or unfamiliar inputs. Bayesian neural networks quantify such uncertainty by replacing every weight with a probability distribution, but sampling many distributions at prediction time overwhelms deterministic digital hardware. Here we show that the temporal speckle of broadband light provides a native physical representation of probabilistic weights. Random beating among the frequency components of individually amplitude-bandwidth programmed spectral channels enables optical-encoding of mean and variance in each channel independently. This way, a single broadband light source stores many probabilistic weights in parallel and delivers mutually uncorrelated samples without requiring computationally demanding random-number generation. translated_title: 时间散斑为不确定性感知的光子人工智能提供概率权重
translated_abstract: 人工智能正日益用于指导安全关键场景中的决策，然而当神经网络面对模糊的观测或陌生的输入时，仍可能表现得过度自信。贝叶斯神经网络通过将每个权重替换为概率分布来量化这种不确定性，但在预测时对多个分布进行采样会使确定性数字硬件不堪重负。本文表明，宽带光的时间散斑为概率权重提供了一种天然的物理表示。在各自独立进行幅度与带宽编程的光谱信道之间，频率分量之间的随机拍频使每个信道能够独立地对均值和方差进行光学编码。通过这种方式，单个宽带光源即可并行存储大量概率权重，并输出彼此互不相关的样本，而无需计算开销高昂的随机数生成。我们利用这一机制在一种超……（原文截断）
tldr: 本文提出利用宽带光的时间散斑效应作为概率权重的天然物理载体，使单个宽带光源能并行存储并采样大量互不相关的概率权重，无需高计算开销的随机数生成，从而为不确定性感知的光子人工智能提供了硬件基础。
en_tdlr: Temporal speckle of broadband light natively encodes probabilistic weights, allowing a single broadband source to store and sample many mutually uncorrelated probabilistic weights in parallel without computationally demanding random-number generation, enabling uncertainty-aware photonic AI.
